played in the National Football League and
under intercoliegiate rules. We would like to
call your attention to these major differences:
1. The goal posts are on the goal line (not
2. Forward passes are permitted from any
point to the line of scrimmage (not thrown
3. The penalty for a forward pass thrown
beyond the line of scrimmage is loss of down
and five yards from the spot such pass is made.
4. A forward pass on fourth down is not a
touchback if it goes over the goal line providing
In other words if the pass was thrown from
the 25-yard line on fourth down it reverts to
the defending team at that point.
5. On a kickoff the receiving team is not
required to have five players within five yards
to use tees in making kickoffs.
6. The penalty for clipping is 25 yards
7. The ball is not dead when the runner
touches the ground unless definitely in the

The New York Giants today start the final
stretch drive which will gain them the playoff
for the title or cast them in the same role as
National League champions of the past few years.
No champion has yet been able to repeat and
that is the thought which the Giants will carry
It isn't necessary to remind the Giant players
of the task confronting them when the Redskins
come to the Polo Grounds on December 3. That
scoreless tie in Washington early this season in
which the Redskins pushed the Giants all over
the field is still fresh in the minds of the Giant
For that matter Pittsburgh gave the Giants a
tough battle out in the Smoky City, leading
7 to 0 at the half before Ward Cuff took two
touchdown passes from Ed Danowski to sew up
the game in the third period. Nor was Brooklyn
any casy task for the Giants over at Ebbets Field
three weeks ago when Ace Parker, Ralph Kerche-
val and Co. played the Giants to a 7 to 6 margin,
Kercheval missing two field goal attempts in the
last period which would have sent the Giants to
defeat and kept them from perching at the top
of the eastern race tied with the Redskins.
